text.tspan: Lanes are responsibilities, not nine processes. Model lanes use configured Codex / Claude adapters.
Worker and checker calls reach Gateway through ferb mcp + authenticated daemon RPC (expanded in HLD).
Solid arrows = calls / events, dashed arrows = results. Numbering is a reading order, not fixed action IDs.
[Stop-only request or old run still settling]
[Interactive stop / retry / continue of a prior task]
3 — MODEL-DRIVEN TOOL LOOP (zero or more calls)
A tool error is an observation, the worker decides its next action.

g.text: [Owner needed in an unattended scheduled run]

text.tspan: [Worker observes, chooses an installed action, then observes again]
4 — COMPLETION CHECKS (automatic after worker claims done)
Checker is read-only by PROMPT, not a restricted tool list.
It may inspect worker-owned tabs through validated handoff.
[status = done, success conditions present, not stopped]
[Nonempty cleanup records or errors, not stopped]

g.text: [Blocked / failed / needs_user after execution or review]

text.tspan: [Worker attempts, continue only on dispatch retry and not stopped]
No new recovery after stop. In-flight consequential actions can be unknown.
Cleanup still runs. Closing chat / Ctrl-D is NOT task.stop.

g.text: [Explicit stop may interrupt ANY active task step]

text.tspan: Independent failure lifecycle: silent worker/checker → watchdog cancellation → attempt failure / recovery.
Explicit owner / process / sleep waits suspend the silence timer. Daemon restart marks active tasks interrupted
and unresolved ledger entries unknown, it does not automatically replay the task.

svg.text: send(session, text), task can outlive this connection
retrieve memory, recent chat/tasks and environment
Bounded context, exact resumable task IDs
Rearm recurrence or finish one-shot timer
Separate schedule session, unattended if a task starts
Search relevant daily activity and action registry,
reply / clarify / task, optional control and memory/timer changes
One repair call with validation problems
Resolve exact task within this conversation
Apply quote-checked changes, record actual results
Interactive: save reply and pending clarification if needed
Reply or question, scheduled clarification → needs_user
Persist root + logical worker, task specification,
success conditions and original request context
Refresh relevant context, include previous reports,
artifacts and unknown prior ledger actions
worker.md + goal / owner words / conditions / tools
Start selected worker type with structured report schema
Authenticate grant via RPC, check stop / task / tool / scopes,
Structured error, do not execute the action
Answer from context OR ask owner
HTTPS field origin and supported input
Error before asking owner, no code entered
Code directly to pending secure reply
Secret or no answer, clear pending code
Revalidate ref / origin, sealed single-field fill
Raw code never goes to a model or normal tool log
Finish span, ledger done / failed, or unknown
Redacted result + status, image if present
Images reach model, not persisted in tool spans
Or mapped runtime / provider / unusable-report failure
Read task tab URLs / account observations as needed
Direct file / URL checks → true or false,
account / ledger / other or unknown checks → model judgment
Own run token, same worker type and capability scopes
Same validated execution path as worker
Each condition: true / false / unknown + evidence
Any false / unknown condition makes outcome blocked
Checker failure becomes unknown, not success
Close ordinary owned tabs, detach borrowed / kept tabs,
stop ordinary shell processes, preserve background=true
Reconcile report + checks + actual final resource state
Revised outcome / answer, may invalidate done
Keep bounded attempt reports in memory
Model / tool diagnostics are already persisted
dispatch.md + current report / checks / previous attempts
Leave loop with needs_user and question
This ends the attempt, it is not a waiting owner.ask call
Mark stop, stop wins over success / recovery
Cancel in-flight calls, reject new task calls
Final idempotent release on ALL exits
(done path may already have released everything)
Final resource reconciliation, no further worker loop here
Final reviewed outcome, or failure if review fails
Persist final task status, answer, spans and outcome
